entities.summary: Ricardo Cano is a former professional tennis player from Argentina. Most of his tennis success was in doubles. During his career, he won four doubles titles and finished runner-up six times. Ricardo Cano was a athletes & competitors from Buenos Aires (b. 1951-02-26, Buenos Aires).
